p: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written,
a: The just shall live by faith
d: The law of God is holy and true
The gift of grace is eternal life

the light of truth
the hope of glory

p: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that

he hath forgiven all our sins

p: Nay, in all these things we are

partakers of the holy heavenly calling

p: For I am persuaded, that
a: neither death, nor life

neither height, nor depth
neither principalities, nor powers

p: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth

p: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil;

love one another with pure heart

a: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation

d: Standing fast in faith; steadfast in truth

p: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you,

keep the unity of the Spirit
do good unto the brethren

p: And the God of peace

shall give you peace through Jesus Christ

a: God is faithful

The Lord reigneth

p: But of him are ye in Christ Jesus, who of God is made unto us

s: , and redemption:

grace, and peace, and holy lovingkindness
truth, and power, and heavenly salvation

p: For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid,

d: the Lord of all glory
the rock of our salvation
the holy Son of God

p: For ye are bought with a price: therefore

p: Now ye are

d: the temple of God
the flock of peace
the heirs of life

a: Beareth all things, believeth all things

d: Seeketh not her own, thinketh no evil

p: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that
a: Christ died for our sins
s: according to the scriptures;
d: the Lord was raised in power
he was delivered for our peace
he gave his life for the world

p: And that he was buried, and that
a: he rose again the third day
s: according to the scriptures:
d: he ascended into the heavens
he sat down on the right hand
he shall come again in glory

p: But
a: now is Christ risen from the dead
s: , and become the firstfruits of them that slept.
d: the day of eternal redemption is come
the victory over death is accomplished
the glorious kingdom of heaven is at hand

p: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written,
a: Death is swallowed up in victory
d: The corruptible hath put on life
The saints shall reign for evermore
The kingdom of darkness is destroyed

p: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is,
a: there is liberty
d: there is peace
the Lord reigneth
truth shall abide

p: But we have

the heavenly hope in our souls
the glorious gospel in our hearts

this present sorrow
our heavy burden

we seek the heavenly kingdom
we walk in uprightness of heart

p: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and
a: the communion of the Holy Ghost

the glorious hope of salvation
the heavenly joy of our Lord

p: Wherefore thou art
a: no more a servant, but a son

partakers of the holy calling
bought with a great price

seek the kingdom of the Lord

p: Meekness, temperance:
a: against such there is no law
d: in these things is great peace
these are the fruits of light
such shall inherit the kingdom

a: that shall he also reap
d: he shall find his reward
his soul shall be judged
he shall inherit life

p: But God forbid that I should glory, save
a: in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ
s: , by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

in the rich mercy of our living Redeemer
in the eternal throne of righteous truth

p: In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were

d: cleansed by the precious blood of the Lamb
justified through faith in his holy name
sanctified unto the everlasting inheritance

a: Not of works, lest any man should boast
d: According to the purpose of his holy will
By the free gift of everlasting righteousness
Through the operation of the Holy Spirit of God

a: For he is our peace
s: , who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;
d: He is the true light
God is our salvation
He hath redeemed us

p: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but
a: fellowcitizens with the saints
s: , and of the household of God;
d: partakers of the holy promise
heirs of the heavenly kingdom
children of the living God

p: And to know
a: the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge

d: the glorious mystery of the gospel of God
the heavenly peace that keepeth all hearts
the unsearchable riches of his holy grace

p: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye

s: wherewith ye are called,
d: keep the unity of the Spirit
stand fast in holy righteousness
abound in all truth and love

p: Endeavouring to keep
a: the unity of the Spirit
s: in the bond of peace.
d: the fellowship of saints
the righteousness of faith
the peace of Jesus Christ

p: Be ye therefore
a: followers of God, as dear children
d: servants of Christ in all sincerity
heirs of the kingdom of heaven
children of the glorious light

p: I thank my God
a: upon every remembrance of you
d: in all my holy prayers to God
for your fellowship in the gospel
with thanksgiving for your love

d: all power in the heavens and the earth
the everlasting throne of righteousness
the glory of the Father from beginning

a: the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus

the unsearchable riches of the holy covenant
the eternal inheritance prepared for all saints

p: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do,
a: forgetting those things which are behind

d: pressing toward the mark of our high calling
laying aside every weight of sin that doth beset
looking unto the glorious author of our faith

a: Rejoice in the Lord alway
s: : and again I say, Rejoice.
d: Give thanks unto our God
Praise the King of glory
Sing praises with the heart

p: But my God
a: shall supply all your need
s: according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
d: will establish all your ways
shall preserve your spirit
will give you perfect peace

p: Who is
a: the image of the invisible God
s: , the firstborn of every creature:
d: the prince of the heavenly host
the author of eternal salvation
the righteous judge of all men

p: And he is
a: the head of the body, the church
s: : who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
d: the foundation of our holy faith
the prince of everlasting peace
the mediator of the new covenant

p: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is
a: Christ in you, the hope of glory
d: the word of life, which is eternal
the holy spirit of promise in power
the glorious riches of his grace

p: If ye then be risen with Christ,
a: seek those things which are above

d: walk in the light of his holy truth
put on the new man in righteousness
cleave unto the Lord with all your heart

p: And let
a: the peace of God
s: rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

the holy spirit
the love of Christ

p: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all
a: in the name of the Lord Jesus
s: , giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
d: before the presence of our God
according to all the holy law
unto the praise of the Father

p: Remembering without ceasing
a: your work of faith, and labour of love

d: your fellowship in the holy gospel of peace
your patience in all trials and tribulations
your righteous walk before the living God

d: to keep the commandments of Jesus
to walk in the path of righteousness
to wait for the heavenly kingdom

p: And the Lord make you to
a: increase and abound in love
s: one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:
d: walk worthy of the Lord God
stand fast in the holy truth
cleave unto all righteousness

d: shall our joy be full for ever
shall all sorrow pass away
we shall reign in righteousness

a: Rejoice evermore
d: Pray without fear
Give thanks always
Stand fast in hope

a: Brethren, pray for us
d: Walk in holy peace
Serve the Lord alway
Fear not the wicked

p: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that
a: your faith groweth exceedingly
s: , and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;
d: ye walk worthy of the Lord
your love aboundeth in all
ye stand fast in the truth

p: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ
a: may be glorified in you
s: , and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
d: shall be revealed on high
will give you perfect peace
doth rule in all your hearts

a: the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ

the heavenly inheritance of saints
the holy promise of his coming

p: And the Lord direct your hearts
a: into the love of God
s: , and into the patient waiting for Christ.
d: in the path of peace
unto the holy kingdom
through the true faith

p: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ
a: be with you all. Amen
d: abide with your spirit
give you holy peace
dwell in your hearts

p: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith:
a: Grace, mercy, and peace
s: , from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
d: Faith, and holy love
Glory, and great praise
Truth, and perfect joy

p: And the grace of our Lord was
a: exceeding abundant with faith and love
s: which is in Christ Jesus.
d: manifested unto all them that believe
full of heavenly peace and righteous joy
established according to the holy promise

p: Now unto
a: the King eternal, immortal, invisible
s: , the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
d: the Lord of lords, and maker of all
the righteous judge, holy and true
the rock of ages, glorious on high

p: For this is
a: good and acceptable in the sight of God
s: our Saviour;
d: the true commandment of the holy gospel
well pleasing before our heavenly Father
righteous according to the ancient promise

a: to come unto the knowledge of the truth

to receive the forgiveness of their sins
to walk in the light of his holy presence

p: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because
a: we trust in the living God

we preach the word of truth
we walk by faith and peace

p: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou
a: stir up the gift of God
s: , which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
d: walk in the light of truth
keep the holy commandment
stand fast in the gospel

redeemed us from all iniquity
sealed us with the Holy Spirit

a: be strong in the grace
s: that is in Christ Jesus.
d: walk in the holy faith
cleave unto all truth
stand in the light of God

we shall reign in his kingdom
we shall inherit life eternal

s: , apt to teach, patient,
d: blameless in the faith
holy before the Lord
righteous in your way

truth shall abide
peace is restored

walking in all his truth

blameless before all the saints

a: Grace to you, and peace

d: Mercy, and holy joy

rejoicing in the fellowship of the gospel
beseeching the Lord to establish thy house

a: Hearing of thy love and faith
